violations.text: Queso, white sauce and garlic oil, which was prepared on site, was observed held beyond the 7 days. Food items exceeding the 7 days shall be discarded. See disposal. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

At the time of inspection, ROP lobster was thawing with package intact. Reduced oxygen packaging fish that bears a label indicating that it is to be kept frozen until time of use shall be removed from the reduced oxygen environment. Temperature was observed at 42 degrees Fahrenheit, see disposal. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

1) The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the Quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. 2) The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the fan has an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026

The wall/ceiling in the back kitchen are constructed of concrete. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026

Protective shielding is not provided for the lights in the back kitchen area. Light bulbs must be shielded, coated, or otherwise shatter-resistant in areas where there is exposed food; clean equipment, utensils, and linens; or unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen is lacking signage. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2025
Hot water is not reaching a minimum temperature of 110F, observed at 95F. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2025
